in the United States was 3200 mg/day in adult men and 2400 mg/day in adult women (Bailey et al., 2015). Because African
Americans have a relatively low intake of potassium and a high prevalence of high BP and salt sensitivity, this subgroup of the pop-
ulation would especially beneﬁt from an increased potassium intake.
In the generally healthy population with normal kidney function, a potassium intake from foods higher than 3400 mg/day
